components.name: OverflowActions
components.doc: A toolbar that always fits. It measures every action once in a hidden row, then shows as many as the current width allows and moves the rest into a "more" menu. Buttons leave and return with a short scale, and the "more" button glides to its new place on a layout spring.

components.name: OverflowActionsPreview
components.doc: Ready preview: a small editor whose toolbar you can resize with the handle, the arrow keys or the width presets.

members.name: label
members.doc: Visible text in the bar and in the menu.

members.name: pressed
members.doc: Marks a toggle as on (`aria-pressed` in the bar, a check state in the menu). Leave undefined for plain actions.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disabled actions stay in place but cannot be used.

members.name: onSelect
members.doc: Runs when the action is used, from the bar or from the menu.

members.name: actions
members.doc: Actions in priority order: the last ones move into the menu first.

members.name: onAction
members.doc: Called with the action id whenever an action is used.

members.name: onOverflowChange
members.doc: Called when the set of actions that moved into the menu changes.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the toolbar root.
